body:
**Checked against PR #8179 (#7656), which lands in `computeMetadataDiagnostics` — the exact function this card is about. Verdict: it does not deepen this finding, and it slightly strengthens the case for it.**

I attached a warning to this card an hour ago: *"a change to what `computeMetadataDiagnostics` is fed could fix one and deepen the other."* #8179 is that change, so here is the check rather than the assumption.

**What #8179 does:** the function previously stripped `_diagnostics` only, via a private one-key helper that predated `_draft` joining `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS`. It now calls the shared `stripReadDecorations`, removing **every** declared read decoration before the re-parse.

**Why that does not touch this card:**

- This card's subject row (a runtime-created `field`, read by name) carries no read decoration other than `_diagnostics` itself. Stripping *more* keys leaves its verdict exactly where it was — **`valid: true`**. The reported shape is unchanged.
- The two cards fail on **different axes**. #7656 was a **wrong value on the right axis** — a well-formed document reported malformed because the reader judged its own badge. This card is a **missing axis** — the document genuinely *is* well-formed, and there is no field in which to say "and nothing consumes it". #8179 corrects values; it adds no axis.

**Why it strengthens the case:**

#8179 adds a drift guard pinning that **every** member of `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS` is invisible to the verdict, and an anti-loosening pin keeping the item schema closed against `_draft`. Together those make the function's contract sharper and more explicit: **the verdict is computed purely over the document, deliberately and now test-enforced.** That is precisely the premise this card rests on — `valid` is document-scoped by design and correctly computed, so ⛔ the fix here is *not* to make it return `false`. After #8179 that design intent is pinned rather than merely commented, which makes "add a separate effectivity signal" the clearly correct shape and "flip the boolean" clearly wrong.

**Unchanged for whoever grades this card:** the ask is still to decide what a read-time diagnostic owes a caller about *effectivity*, and it still survives #7893 either way. The `lock` / `editable` / `deletable` half is untouched by #8179 and remains untraced.

⚠️ One sequencing note: if this card is ever implemented, it will land in the same function #8179 just changed. Read #8179's final diff first — its comment block explains why the strip lives where it does, and an effectivity signal added without that context could easily reintroduce a private subset of the decoration list, which is the exact defect #7656 was.

**Findings-triage round — HELD as `finding`. Recording why, so the hold is a decision rather than a card nobody got to.**

Premise re-checked on `origin/main`: `deletable` is still asserted at 4 sites in `protocol.ts`, so the observation stands. It is held anyway, for three reasons that are about *shape*, not doubt.

**1. It is a contract-shape question, not a defect.** The ask — an "in effect" axis on the `_diagnostics` envelope — **widens a published response surface**. Under this repo's mechanical border test that is not a bug fix and not PM-delegable; it needs a maintainer ruling with a four-cornered card face. ⛔ Promoting it to `pm:queue` would hand a dev a decision it is not allowed to make, and the honest exits (`needs_decision`) would just spend a dispatch to arrive back here.

**2. It is one of three cards on one envelope, pointing different directions — and they must be read together.**

- **this card** — `valid: true` is wrong *because nothing consumes the row*
- **#7656** — `valid: false` is wrong *because the read injects `_draft` and then validates it*
- **#8154** — measured that the diagnostics **ordering** is load-bearing: they must be computed on the **raw stored body BEFORE** redaction, or `valid:false` flips to `valid:true` and destroys #8081 item 3's inventory badge

⇒ ⚠️ **A change to what `computeMetadataDiagnostics` is fed could fix one of these and deepen another.** Ruling them one at a time is how this lane produced three cards from one seam twice already. Whoever writes the decision card should carry all three.

**3. `valid:true` is correctly computed and must not simply be flipped.** `computeMetadataDiagnostics` resolves the type's Zod schema and `safeParse`s the document, so `valid` means *"this isolated document is well-formed"* — nothing more. That document-scoping is a **deliberate good property**: the same function backs the save path's 422 and the read path's diagnostics, so a document's verdict cannot depend on whether it was being saved or opened. The gap is a **missing signal**, not a wrong value.

**Release condition:** promote when a maintainer decision card covering the envelope as a whole (this + #7656 + #8154's ordering constraint) is written and ruled. ⛔ Do not promote it alone, and ⛔ do not fold it into an unrelated card that happens to touch `metadata-diagnostics.ts`.

Evidence, all against `origin/main`:
- #8496 retired exactly one producing door (`field` → `allowRuntimeCreate: false`). The registry still declares `allowRuntimeCreate: true` on **16 types** (object, hook, seed, mapping, view, page, dashboard, app, action, report, dataset, flow, external_catalog, translation, email_template, doc — `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:653ff`).
- The envelope is unchanged: `computeMetadataDiagnostics` still judges the isolated document only, and the #8179 pins deliberately enforce that — so any stored row whose consumer never reads it still reports `valid: true`, with no effectivity axis.
- Consumers that never see stored rows are documented live in open cards: #8722 (overlay merge not folded into `MetadataService.list()`, so some consumers never read runtime rows) and #9190 (reference panel blind by construction to 20+ declared types). The class survives the single-door retirement.

**Decision asked of the maintainer** — what a read-time diagnostic owes a caller about *effectivity*, ruled once for the envelope as a whole (this card + #7656's document-scoping pins + #8154's ordering constraint that diagnostics are computed on the raw stored body BEFORE redaction):

- **Option A — add an effectivity axis** to the meta read envelope (a new published field), computed from the loader/consumer side.
- **Option B — keep retiring inert doors one at a time** (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, the #7893 route): no new surface; each remaining `allowRuntimeCreate: true` type gets its consumer verified or its door closed.
- **Option C — do nothing**: accept `valid` as document-scoped and say so in docs.

Four-prong card face:
- **Platform long-term coherence** — B shrinks the inert surface itself; A adds one axis but leaves the doors open and creates a permanent envelope obligation; C leaves the recurring three-cards-per-seam pattern in place.
- **Measured business pull** — the sharpest user-reachable instance (runtime `field`) is already retired; remaining pull is Studio/operator diagnostics fidelity. No user-blocking failure measured today.
- **AI-agent error-resistance** — `valid: true` on a row nothing consumes teaches an agent its authoring took effect; A is the loud signal, B removes the trap at the door (louder still), C preserves the trap.
- **Startup scope discipline** — B is incremental and already the practiced route; A is declare-and-maintain with zero consumers of the new axis today.

**Recommendation: Option B** (three of four prongs; A wins only on breadth of signal). Standing constraints either way: ⛔ flipping `valid` is settled wrong (#8179 pins); any implementation lands in `computeMetadataDiagnostics` and must read #8179's diff first; #8154's compute-before-redaction ordering is load-bearing.

**Ruled: Option B — no effectivity axis is added to the meta read envelope. The route is continued per-door retirement (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, the #7893 pattern).**
- Each remaining `allowRuntimeCreate: true` type (16 today) gets its consumer verified or its door closed, one card at a time, as the practiced route — no new published envelope field, no declare-and-maintain surface with zero consumers.
- Standing constraints re-affirmed: ⛔ flipping `valid` is settled wrong (#8179 pins); `computeMetadataDiagnostics` stays document-scoped; #8154's compute-before-redaction ordering is load-bearing. A short docs sentence stating `valid` is document-scoped (the honest half of option C) may ride any nearby docs change.
- The per-type retirement worklist is backlog production in the normal lanes (triage grades each door on its own merits), not a program card here.

This card's decision is made and its route is the existing practice — nothing further is dispatchable from it. Closing as completed; #7656 / #8154 pins stand as constraints of record.
